title.zh: CLARITY Act’s biggest Senate vote could happen before the bill is actually finished
title.en: CLARITY Act’s biggest Senate vote could happen before the bill is actually finished

current_state.zh: Republicans released revised CLARITY Act text adding a CFTC framework for identifying controlled protocols, setting up a Sept. 15 Senate cloture vote that needs 60 votes to open debate and amendments on unresolved disputes.
